note: Shared sound library. gain_db values follow the style guide §8.3 (relative to VO).

paper-slap.description: Paper slap — photo cutout pop (on overshoot frame)

turn-impact.description: Bass drop-out + soft impact — The Turn

low-rumble.description: Soft subtle low rumble — ominous/danger underscore texture under a phrase (dry, no boom)
low-rumble.use: Low-frequency tension bed under a single serious line (e.g. chain-reaction, disaster archival)

button-click.description: Chunky mechanical button click, dry — v07 term 'MECHANICAL BUTTON CLICK'
button-click.use: Text/word pop-in (tactile mapping default for per-word title builds)

sticky-peel.description: Soft sticky-note adhesive peel — v07 term 'STICKY NOTE PEEL'
sticky-peel.use: Sticker/logo chip slap-in and label chips (on the overshoot frame, like paper-slap)

page-flick.description: Quick single page flick, snappy paper flip — v07 term 'QUICK PAGE FLICK'
page-flick.use: Fast card/wipe transitions (diagonal paper wipe); snappier than page-turn

circuit-breaker.description: Heavy circuit-breaker switch clack — v07 term 'CIRCUIT BREAKER ON'
circuit-breaker.use: Big 'switch on' reveals: dark→light card flips, spotlight on, hard state changes

polaroid-eject.description: Polaroid motor whir + eject pop — v07 term 'POLAROID EJECT POP'
polaroid-eject.use: Photo/receipt slide-out reveals (longer than shutter — use when the photo travels in)

cassette-click.description: Cassette snapped into a deck, plastic clunk — v07 term 'VHS CASSETTE SNAP-IN'
cassette-click.use: Element locking into place: grid cells, list rows, panel docks

pencil-scratch.description: Pencil scratching a short line on paper — v07 term 'PENCIL SCRATCH'
pencil-scratch.use: Hand-drawn annotation draw-on (arrows, boxes, chart lines) — §8.3 chart-draw level

wood-tap.description: Single dry wood-block tap — v07 term 'WOOD BLOCK TAP'
wood-tap.use: List-item lands, count-up final thock, small solid arrivals

ugc-whoosh-punch.description: UGC: tight whoosh into punchy impact — hook title slam, hard cuts

ugc-bass-hit.description: UGC: 808 bass drop impact — beat drops, CTA lands, layered under whoosh

ugc-riser.description: UGC: short synth riser into a cut — place so it peaks ON the cut (sync_s=peak)

ugc-swish.description: UGC: airy app-swipe swish — panels sliding in, UI transitions

ugc-pop.description: UGC: snappy bubble pop — emphasis word pops, badge stagger runs

ugc-click.description: UGC: crisp phone tap click — subtle UI accents

ugc-ding.description: UGC: bright success chime — CTA, positive reveal

ugc-zoom.description: UGC: zoom whoosh with punch — punch-ins, cut-backs

ugc-bed-hype.description: UGC: 130BPM hype trap, 808s + hats — energetic influencer ads (ElevenLabs)

ugc-bed-house.description: UGC: tech house groove — upbeat product ads (lyria-3 fallback)
